forbidden.name: no-cycles
forbidden.comment: Modules must not import each other in a circle, not even through type imports.

forbidden.name: db-imports-no-domain-module
forbidden.comment: The database layer (apps/server/src/db) is the bottom layer: it imports nothing from the modules above it, only vocabulary.ts (value lists, below db; ADR 0053).

forbidden.name: modules-import-no-assembly
forbidden.comment: The root files that assemble the server (app, compose, start, main, worker, site-sources) import the modules, never the other way; only src/scripts/ may use them (ADR 0053).

forbidden.name: routes-use-no-drizzle
forbidden.comment: Route files speak HTTP and call services; queries belong in a service or the db layer.

forbidden.name: routes-use-no-db-client
forbidden.comment: Route files do not touch the database client; a service holds it (db/schema.js stays allowed for its value lists; ADR 0053).

forbidden.name: mcp-tools-use-no-drizzle
forbidden.comment: MCP tool files speak MCP and call services; their queries belong in mcp/read-service.ts or a domain service (db/schema.js stays allowed for its value lists).

forbidden.name: ui-imports-no-page
forbidden.comment: Shared components (apps/web/src/ui) must not depend on a page (a component file at the top of apps/web/src).

forbidden.name: lib-imports-no-page
forbidden.comment: Web helpers and data hooks (apps/web/src/lib) must not depend on a page (ADR 0053).

forbidden.name: api-imports-only-query-inputs-from-lib
forbidden.comment: api.ts takes from lib/ only the types and constants of its queries' inputs: lib/logbook, sites-list, tools, waiting-push and the live channel's health (ADR 0053, amendment of 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-07).
